const descriptor: TypedPropertyDescriptor<number> = { value: 2, writable: false };
console.log(descriptor.value, descriptor.writable);

const source = { a: 1, b: 'text' };
const descriptors = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(source);
const a: number | undefined = descriptors.a.value;
const b: string | undefined = descriptors.b.value;
console.log(a, b, descriptors.a.enumerable);

const target = {};
Object.defineProperty(target, 'hidden', { value: 42, enumerable: false });
console.log(Object.keys(target).length);

const marker: ThisType<{ value: number }> = {};
console.log(marker);

const objectKey: WeakKey = {};
const symbolKey: WeakKey = Symbol('key');
console.log(typeof objectKey, typeof symbolKey);
